rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for professional standards, professional workers, and tongue-in-cheek labels such as 專業吹水.

example.english: The service at this restaurant is really professional.
example.traditional: 呢間餐廳啲服務真係好專業。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 fuk6 mou6 zan1 hai6 hou2 zyun1 jip6

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a member of a recognized profession or a white-collar professional.

example.english: That professional at the clinic is very patient.
example.traditional: 呢間診所嗰位專業人士好有耐性。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 zan2 so2 go2 wai2 zyun1 jip6 jan4 si6 hou2 jau5 noi6 sing3

rows.note: Use this when the main point is that the person is an expert, not merely a professional by occupation.

example.english: That expert is a professional in this field.
example.traditional: 嗰位專家係呢方面嘅專業人士。
example.jyutping: go2 wai2 zyun1 gaa1 hai6 ni1 fong1 min6 ge3 zyun1 jip6 jan4 si6

rows.note: Use this when the point is that the occupation is someone’s full-time paid livelihood, rather than their professional standard or mock-expert behavior.

example.english: They quit their part-time job and now work as a full-time professional photographer.
example.traditional: 佢辭咗份兼職，而家做全職攝影師。
example.jyutping: keoi5 ci4 zo2 fan6 gim1 zik1 ji4 gaa1 zou6 cyun4 zik1 sip3 jing2 si1

rows.jyutping: kaau3 A wan2 sik6 ge3 jan4
rows.note: Use this construction when specifying the activity from which someone earns a living.

example.english: I'm a professional who makes a living teaching piano.
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai6 kaau3 gaau3 kam4 wan2 sik6 ge3 jan4
